description: This file defines a React functional component called NavBar, which serves as a top navigation bar for the application. It handles user authentication status, displays app title, theme toggle, and logout/login links, and integrates with routing and authentication context.

methods.name: NavBar({ onToggleTheme, theme })
methods.description: React functional component rendering the navigation bar with user info, theme toggle, and login/logout controls.

methods.name: handleLogout
methods.description: Asynchronous function to sign out the user and navigate to login page.
